name: isntgram-ai

scripts.type-check: pnpm exec tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm exec tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm exec tsc -p packages/shared-types/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.validate: pnpm run lint:all && pnpm run type-check && pnpm test -- --watchAll=false && pnpm run build:all
scripts.test:e2e: NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO_ENABLED=true NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO_EMAIL=demo@isntgram.ai NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO_PASSWORD=demo pnpm run build:all && playwright test
scripts.contracts:generate: pnpm --filter api openapi:generate && pnpm exec openapi-typescript apps/api/openapi.json --default-non-nullable=false -o packages/shared-types/src/openapi.ts && pnpm exec prettier --write apps/api/openapi.json packages/shared-types/src/openapi.ts
scripts.contracts:check: git ls-files --error-unmatch apps/api/openapi.json packages/shared-types/src/openapi.ts >/dev/null && pnpm run contracts:generate && git diff --exit-code -- apps/api/openapi.json packages/shared-types/src/openapi.ts
scripts.dev:all: pnpm run dev:db && pnpm --filter @isntgram-ai/shared-types build && concurrently -n web,api -c green,cyan "NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:3001 INTERNAL_API_URL=http://localhost:3001 pnpm --filter web dev" "pnpm --filter api start:dev"

packages/shared-types/**/*.{js,jsx,ts,ts: bash -c 'cd packages/shared-types && pnpm exec eslint src/**/*.ts --fix'

_comment: Note: CVE-2024-21538 in cross-spawn is a known issue with Jest 30.0.5. The vulnerability is in jest-changed-files/node_modules/execa which is a development-only dependency. This is tracked in .trivyignore and will be resolved when Jest updates jest-changed-files.
